toolStripDescription: The wide status strip view: what needs you, the robots and the day's deliveries.
toolHistoryDescription: The last month's sessions and agents, by day, with how each one ended.
toolSetupDescription: Connect Claude Code, Codex and Cursor so their sessions show up in harbard.
passwordNotice: harbard never asks you for a password. If a window asks for one and you didn't trigger it, cancel it.
flagHintUnlabeled: The first line doesn't start with START, BLOCKED, FINDING or DONE.
flagHintTooLong: The protocol asks for messages under 1,200 characters; the rest goes in a report.
flagHintRepeat: Identical to an earlier message from this agent.
flagHintJargon: The line for you should be in plain language; the technical detail goes below, under “Technical details”.
noDelivery: Nobody can read this message for this agent right now
deliveryReasonStale: its main session has gone quiet
deliveryReasonEnded: its main session already ended on the bus
deliveryReasonNotOnBus: its main session isn't on the harbard bus
checkRuleTitle: A rule was approved: “{text}”. Was this you?
checkRuleText: Every session reads it. Keep leaves it; Revoke removes it.
checkContextTitle: Your Context for agents changed: “{text}”. Was this you?
checkContextText: Every session reads it. Revoke goes back to the previous one.
checkContextClearedTitle: Your Context for agents was deleted. Was this you?
checkContextClearedText: Revoke goes back to the previous one.
checkMemorySinkTitle: Saving to external memory was allowed. Was this you?
checkMemorySinkText: The rules you mark will be saved to external memory in your name. Revoke turns it off.
checkOtherTitle: Something changed what agents read. Was this you?
twoWritersTitleTwo: Two agents in the same checkout
twoWritersHistory: They no longer write at the same time; kept as history.
unansweredInChannel: Nobody has answered your message in #{channel}
unansweredToAgent: Nobody has answered your message to {agent}
dormantText: {name} has been mid-turn doing nothing since {time} ({duration}).
sessionGone: Its session is gone; nobody will read this
composerStale: its main session has been silent for {time}; the note will wait for it to come back
nobodyLive: Nobody will read it until a session opens; send anyway?
noReader: This channel has no session to leave a message for
channelStale: the session working here has gone quiet; the note will wait for it to come back
readAllTail: Needs you doesn't change: each alert is resolved separately.
readAllDone: Marked as read: {directs} in Direct messages and {channels} in channels. {tail}
whyIdle: Nobody's working here now · last activity {when}
whyReadOne: Nobody has written here: one agent read it with git
whyReadMany: Nobody has written here: {n} agents read it with git
originLaunched: Its lead launched it with this name
originAuto: From the workshop, suggested by harbard
dmVia: {name} doesn't read this directly: it goes to {reader}, who has to pass it on.
shortcutMarkRead: Mark the open channel or conversation as read
shortcutMention: Mention an agent, a team or the channel
replyNoChannelReader: Nobody in this channel can read it right now
replyTooLong: The message is too long for the bus; shorten it or link a report.
replySaveFailed: Couldn't save the message: harbard isn't responding.
suggestAwayBody: You've been away from the Mac for a while. Agents will carry on with what's already authorised, and you'll see a summary when you're back.
suggestBackBody: You're still set to Away. Switch to Available so agents can reach you?
